name: Security Lights Activate After Panel Closes
description: The panel overhead slides shut. A row of safety lights turns on, casting a steady glow across the area.
related_events: Panel overhead slides shut and safety lights activate

name: Three Figures Climb Icy Steps in Snowstorm
description: In the midst of a heavy snowstorm, three figures make their way up a series of icy steps carved into a massive rock formation. Snow swirls around them as they ascend, each step taken carefully against the biting wind and treacherous footing. The path is steep and slick, but they continue upward, moving steadily through the storm.
related_events: Three figures ascend icy steps during a snowstorm

name: Search Through Rubble in the Rain
description: Rain falls steadily as a group of soldiers spreads across the rubble, sweeping flashlight beams through the dark. Each moves methodically, scanning the debris. Rosaries hang from the bayonets of their rifles, swaying slightly with each step.
related_events: Soldiers search rubble with flashlights during rain

name: Agent and Myers Travel Together in a Truck
description: The agent drove the truck with Myers sitting beside him. They traveled together down the road, the truck moving steadily forward under the agent's control.
related_events: Agent and Myers travel together in a truck

name: Broom Warns Whitman as Nazi Scientist Reaches the Gold Cylinders
description: The Nazi scientist stepped toward the box holding the gold cylinders and paused beside it. Broom turned to Whitman, his voice a fierce whisper. "Listen to me!!! The portal is open!!! We have to stop them!!!"
related_events: Broom issues a fierce warning to Whitman about the open portal
Nazi scientist approaches the box with gold cylinders

name: Work Light Enters Cosmic Slit
description: The edges of the cosmic slit shimmer with vivid, sizzling colors. An alien galaxy glimmers beyond. Without warning, a work light tears loose and hurtles into the slit, vanishing into the radiant rift.
related_events: Work light tears loose and enters cosmic slit

name: Kroenen Oversees Machine Assembly
description: A dozen German soldiers quickly piece together a large steel machine under the watchful gaze of Karl Ruprecht Kroenen. Dressed in black leather and wearing an unusual gas mask, Kroenen stands motionless, observing each step of the assembly. The soldiers work in silence, their movements precise, as the machine takes shape in the dim light.
related_events: Kroenen monitors machine assembly with masked presence
German soldiers assemble large steel machine under supervision

name: Grigory Rises as a Photograph is Taken
description: Grigory screams as his body lifts into the air. His face twists in a mixture of agony and rapture, veins bulging in his neck. In the same moment, someone nearby raises a camera and clicks the shutter, capturing the image.
related_events: Grigory's body rises amid visible distress and ecstasy
Someone takes a photograph of Grigory during his levitation

name: Garbage Truck and Mounted Officer Move Through Crowd
description: The garbage truck advances slowly through a dense crowd, forcing people to step aside and clear a path. Faces flash in the truck's mirrored logo as the vehicle pushes forward. Alongside the truck, a mounted policeman rides in parallel, his horse stepping in rhythm with the truck's steady progress, moving together through the parted crowd.
related_events: Garbage truck moves through crowd causing people to scatter
Mounted policeman rides past the side of the garbage truck

name: Matlin Shows the Photograph and Recalls the Night They Found Him
description: Matlin pulls an old 8x10 photograph from a battered portfolio and hands it over. He looks at it with a quiet smile. The image shows the individual on the night they found him. Matlin remembers the moment clearly. That was the night Broom gave him the name.
related_events: Matlin reveals an old photograph from a battered portfolio
Matlin shares memories of the night they found him
Broom gives a name to the individual on the night they were found

name: The Light That Woke the Giants
description: A six-foot work light tumbles past the massive OGDRU JAHAD, a cluster of seven egg-shaped monoliths of unnatural origin. As the beam sweeps across their translucent surfaces, the creatures inside become visible—horrific forms suspended in silence. One of the giants opens a filmy eye. Then another. And another. Fleshy tentacles stir within the crystalline walls, shifting slowly as if testing the weight of motion after eons of stillness.
related_events: Work light illuminates monoliths containing slumbering creatures
Multiple giants awaken as light passes by
Tentacles move inside crystalline prisons

name: Figure 1 Follows a Firefly into a Hidden Corridor
description: The ice curtain collapses, revealing a rough-walled corridor. Figure 1 sees a glowing firefly inside and follows it into the passage.
related_events: Ice curtain collapses to reveal hidden corridor
Figure 1 spots glowing firefly in the corridor
Figure 1 follows glowing firefly into corridor

name: Kroenen Activates the Machine and Adjusts the Lighting
description: Kroenen throws a switch on the machine. Gears turn and steam pistons drive copper rails upward, lifting two massive metal rings into an upright position. Kroenen grunts and signals for more floodlights to be turned on.
related_events: Kroenen activates machine with switch
Steam pistons lift metal rings into upright position
Kroenen signals to increase lighting

name: Whitman Subdues Matlin as Nazi Scientist Approaches
description: Matlin snaps photographs rapidly, drawing attention. Whitman pulls him down and draws a large bayonet, holding it close as he warns him to stay quiet. Before he can finish, a Nazi scientist stops, having heard the commotion, and turns toward the sound.
related_events: Matlin takes photographs aggressively
Whitman restrains Matlin and draws a bayonet
Whitman threatens Matlin with violence
Nazi scientist detects the commotion

name: Tom Manning Mocks Blurry Hellboy Footage on Live TV
description: During a live television interview, Tom Manning holds up a blurry photograph of Hellboy and questions the poor quality of the image. He compares it to ordinary wedding photos, pointing out that people routinely capture clear pictures at weddings, yet all footage of Hellboy remains out of focus. He then displays a second blurry image, claiming it shows the alleged best man, and gestures toward it with skepticism. The audience responds with applause.
related_events: Manning criticizes blurry footage of Hellboy on live television
Manning displays a blurry photograph of the alleged best man
audience applauds during Manning's television appearance
related_occasions: Live Television Interview With Tom Manning

name: Doctors Review X-Ray and Prepare to Speak with Patient
description: Mechanized rollers move X-Ray films across a backlit screen. Four doctors stand in silence, studying the images. Rain taps against the windows. After a moment, Doctor 1 turns to the others and asks, 'Have you told him yet?' Doctor 2 looks through a glass partition at Broom, a 72-year-old man, who slowly buttons his shirt. A rosary hangs from his wrist.
related_events: Doctors examine X-Ray films under backlit screen
Doctor 1 asks if patient has been informed
Doctor 2 observes Broom preparing after examination

name: Myers Enters the Chamber Behind the Oak Door
description: The elevator comes to a stop in a narrow, dark space. Flickering neon lights illuminate a circular chamber, revealing a large number 51 painted on the floor. Myers approaches a massive oak door, knocks on it, and waits. When there is no response, Myers opens the door and steps inside.
related_events: Elevator stops in narrow dark space
Neon lights illuminate circular chamber
Myers knocks on oak door
Myers enters through oak door

name: Soldiers Advance Through Mountain Tunnel
description: On October 9, 1944, in the pouring rain, soldiers make their way through a short tunnel carved into a Scottish mountainside. Sergeant Whitman moves with them, then raises his hand and signals for the men to spread out. They obey, fanning into positions along the tunnel's interior as Whitman steps up beside Broom.
related_events: Soldiers move through mountain tunnel during heavy rain
Whitman signals troops to spread out

name: Broom Asks to Speak Privately with Whitman
description: Rain drums against the rocky entrance of the tunnel as soldiers move into position inside the mountain. Broom spots Sergeant Whitman and calls out to him urgently. Whitman signals his men to spread out, then approaches. Broom asks to speak in private. Whitman stops, turns, and waits.
related_events: Broom requests private conversation with Whitman

name: Broom and Whitman Dive into a Ditch to Avoid Patrol
description: Broom and Whitman sprint across open ground and dive into a shallow ditch just as a German foot patrol approaches. They lie still, pressed into the dirt, as the soldiers pass nearby, boots crunching on gravel. The patrol moves on without noticing them. Around them, other American soldiers take cover in the underbrush, spreading out below a machine gun nest.
related_events: Broom and Whitman dive into a ditch to avoid German patrol

name: Soldiers Take Cover Below Machine Gun Nest
description: American soldiers spread out quietly, moving into hidden positions beneath a German machine gun nest. Broom and Whitman slide into a ditch just as a German foot patrol passes by. Other GI's crouch low, settling into place, ready to act.
related_events: American soldiers take up positions below machine gun nest

name: Young Matlin in the Submarine Corridor
description: Young Matlin crouches in a narrow submarine corridor lit by a red glow, flipping through a stack of photographic negatives. Around him, pipes and gauges press in from all sides. A squad of Marines hurries past, loading their weapons, forcing him to press back against the wall. Moments later, Sergeant Whitman pushes through the same passage, his uniform dark with sweat, moving steadily down the dim corridor as the submarine hums with activity.
related_events: Young Matlin searches through photographic negatives under red light
Marine squad rushes past Young Matlin while loading weapons
Sergeant Whitman advances through submarine corridor in sweat-soaked uniform
related_occasions: Classified Submarine Mission Off The Coast Of Scotland

name: Police and Emergency Units Secure Machen Library Amid Media Frustration
description: Policemen and mounted officers formed a line at the entrance of the four-story Machen Library, holding back a crowd of TV reporters and onlookers. A Halloween banner overhead read: MAGICK: THE ANCIENT POWER. Amid flashing lights and the hum of activity, a series of black sedan cars approached the entrance. Officers stepped aside, waving the vehicles through without comment. Behind them, a garbage truck with the mirrored logo SQUEAKY CLEAN INC. followed the sedans onto the library grounds. Reporters shouted questions, demanding a statement from the NYPD, but no one responded.
related_events: Police and mounted units manage chaotic scene at library entrance
Line of black sedan cars is waved through library entrance amid chaos
Garbage truck follows sedan cars into library grounds
TV reporters protest lack of statement from NYPD

name: Broom and Whitman Assess Threat and Call for Backup
description: Broom lowers a pair of binoculars and hands them to Whitman. Whitman turns to the radio operator and orders air and sea backup. The radio operator begins cranking the transmitter. A response comes: Londonderry is forty minutes away. Broom says they don't have forty minutes.
related_events: Broom lowers binoculars and passes them to Whitman
Whitman requests air and sea backup via radio operator

name: Broom Receives Response Time and Rejects Delay
description: The radio operator turns the transmitter's crank and brings the device to life. A response comes through: backup from Londonderry is forty minutes away. Broom listens, then speaks firmly, saying they do not have forty minutes.
related_events: Radio operator activates transmitter and reports Londonderry response time
Broom states they do not have forty minutes

name: Broom Secures the Anomaly Site
description: Allied soldiers moved into the ruins. Matlin helped Broom to his feet. Broom reached down and scooped up a sample of thick, white goo from the edge of the smoking machine. He turned to the others and ordered the area cordoned off. 'Something came through,' he said. Whitman stepped forward, voice sharp. 'From where?' Broom didn't answer. He looked toward a 13th-century fresco on the wall, depicting heaven and hell, and pointed at it.
related_events: Allied soldiers enter the ruins
Matlin helps Broom stand up
Broom collects sample of mysterious substance
Broom orders area to be cordoned off
Whitman questions origin of the entity
Broom gestures toward ancient fresco

name: Matlin Takes the Group Photo
description: The soldiers gather together, looking on with curiosity. Matlin adjusts his camera and arranges them into a group. Broom stands beside the creature, smiling, and wraps an arm around it, patting it gently. Matlin steps back, frames the shot, and takes the photograph. The shutter clicks. 'Best photo of my career,' he says.
related_events: Matlin directs soldiers into a group shot
Matlin captures the photograph
Matlin declares the photo as the best of his career

name: Broom Embraces the Creature
description: Broom smiles and wraps his arms around the creature, holding it close. He gently pats its back as the soldiers gather around, watching. The camera flash fires, capturing the moment.
related_events: Broom embraces the creature with paternal affection

name: Broom Gathers Artifacts Under Urgent Call
description: Broom stands with a tarot deck in hand, turning over cards: The Fool, The Moon, and finally The Devil. He moves to a worn-down wooden box filled with books and amulets, slinging it over his shoulder by its leather strap. Whitman's voice cuts through the air, demanding he come topside immediately. Broom selects a small box and a few amulets, then pauses before leaving, his expression tense. He follows Whitman's call, carrying the items with him.
related_events: Broom retrieves a wooden box containing books and amulets
Broom takes a small box and a few amulets
Whitman calls for Broom to come topside

name: Trevor Brüttensholm Draws the Devil in a Tarot Reading
description: Trevor Brüttensholm sat with a tarot deck in hand, spreading the cards face up before him. The Fool appeared, followed by The Moon. He gathered a small box and a few amulets from the worn wooden case. As he prepared to leave, he turned one final card: The Devil, its image facing upward in silence. He paused, then moved toward the exit without a word.
related_events: Trevor Brüttensholm reads Tarot cards during a session
Broom turns the last tarot card revealing The Devil

name: Broom Smiles at Infant Hellboy
description: Professor Broom smiles at the small creature wrapped in a blanket. The infant Hellboy blinks his bright golden eyes, chews on a piece of candy, and twitches his red tail. The two sit together in quiet stillness, the moment undisturbed.
related_events: Broom smiles at Hellboy while he blinks and chews candy

name: Hellboy Sighting Sparks Media Frenzy
description: Tabloid covers and news clippings spread across the country, each proclaiming a Hellboy sighting in Reno. Newscasters deliver dramatic reports, their voices urgent as they describe the alleged appearance of the red-skinned figure. On a daytime talk show, a woman claims to have been Hellboy's bride, shouting over audience boos and cheers before a fistfight breaks out on stage. Grainy, shaky footage plays on screens—a dark shape moving through an alley at night, tail flicking, barely visible in the dim light. A man’s voice, calm and skeptical, observes from the shadows, calling it all a costume, dismissing the chaos as delusion.
related_events: Tabloid covers and news clippings report Hellboy sighting in Reno
TV newscasters read lurid reports about Hellboy
Jerry Springer show features 'I Was Hellboy's Bride'
Hellboy appears in blurry footage crossing an alley

name: Broom Receives Terminal Diagnosis and Declines Treatment
description: The doctor tells Broom he has malignant sarcoma in his lungs, spine, and liver, and gives him about six weeks to live. He offers hospitalization and pain management to make the time more bearable. Broom shakes his head and says he would rather stay home. He continues shuffling his tarot cards, then draws the first one from the deck—Death. He says a second opinion won’t be necessary.
related_events: Doctor delivers terminal cancer diagnosis to Broom
Broom refuses hospitalization and pain management

name: Broom Draws the Death Card and Prepares for His Son's Future
description: After the doctor tells him he has about six weeks to live, Broom sits quietly and shuffles his tarot cards. He draws the first card from the deck and sees it is the Death card. Without speaking, he places it down. He declines hospitalization and pain management, choosing instead to go home. He says he will be making arrangements for his son.
related_events: Broom draws the Death tarot card

name: Broom Rejects Second Opinion
description: The doctor tells Broom he can get a second opinion. Broom looks down at the tarot card in front of him—Death—and shakes his head. He says a second opinion won't be necessary.
related_events: Doctor offers possibility of second opinion

name: The Recording Begins in the Darkroom
description: The red safety light in the darkroom clicks on, casting a dim crimson glow over the old enlargers, porcelain trays, and negatives hanging to dry. A technician's voice cuts through the quiet: 'Get ready, 3-2-1... Roll tape.' The hum of the recorder starts as George Matlin sits amidst the equipment, hands moving through a box of old negatives, the interview beginning.
related_events: Technician activates red safety light in darkroom
Technician initiates tape recording with countdown

name: George Matlin Recounts His War Years
description: In a dimly lit darkroom, George Matlin, a slightly obese, nearsighted man in his seventies, sifts through a box of old negatives. The red glow of the safety light casts a faint hue over the room, illuminating the optical enlargers, porcelain trays, and stills hanging nearby. He pauses, looking directly at the camera, and says he hasn’t spoken about the war in years. People called him crazy, he admits, but insists it’s all real. As the technician’s voice counts down and the tape begins to roll, Matlin begins to speak. He recalls 1944, when he served as a combat photographer aboard an Allied submarine.
related_events: George Matlin recalls his past as a combat photographer
George Matlin searches through a box of old negatives
George Matlin begins recounting wartime experience as submarine photographer

name: Grigory Approaches the Machine with Ilsa and Von Krupt
description: Grigory walks toward the machine, its massive steel and copper clockworks glinting under the floodlights. Rain pours heavily as Ilsa steps beside him, holding an umbrella to shield him. Von Krupt strides alongside, his voice sharp with urgency as he recounts five years of research and construction. He reminds Grigory of the Führer’s expectations. Grigory responds firmly, vowing to deliver the miracle he promised. Nearby, Kroenen opens a polished oak box containing a large gold and copper mecha-glove. Grigory extends his hand, and Kroenen begins attaching the device, connecting it to a network of cables and hoses.
related_events: Grigory approaches the machine under floodlights
Ilsa shields Grigory from rain with an umbrella
Von Krupt emphasizes five years of research and construction
Grigory assures Von Krupt of success and promises a miracle

name: Kroenen Attaches the Mecha-Glove to Grigory
description: Kroenen opens a polished oak box and lifts out a massive gold and copper mecha-glove. He steps toward Grigory and begins fitting the device onto his hand. The glove locks into place with a series of clicks and hisses as cables and hoses connect it to a network of machinery nearby.
related_events: Kroenen reveals the Mecha-Glove from an oak box
Kroenen attaches the Mecha-Glove to Grigory's hand

name: The Portal's Collapse and the Vanishing of Grigory and Ilsa
description: The cosmic portal imploded with sudden, violent force. Grigory's face twisted, stretched like taffy, his body breaking apart as the energy consumed him. Ilsa vanished in the chaos, leaving no trace. When the explosion subsided, only a few burnt rails and a smoking metal glove remained on the ground. The wall nearby held two bloody rails embedded deep, all that was left of Kroenen.
related_events: Cosmic portal implodes violently
Grigory's body disintegrates during portal collapse
Ilsa disappears amid the chaos of the portal collapse

name: Kroenen's Remains in the Wall
description: After the portal collapsed, two bloody rails were found embedded in the wall where Kroenen had been pinned. His body was gone, reduced to those remnants, motionless and broken.
related_events: Kroenen is reduced to bloody remains pinned in the wall

name: Allies Advance Amid Ongoing Combat
description: The portal collapsed in a violent implosion, leaving behind scorched rails and a smoking metal glove. Grigory and Ilsa vanished in the blast, their bodies disintegrating as the rift sealed. Kroenen was gone too, only two bloodied rails embedded in the wall marking where he had been pinned. Despite the chaos and the fighting that still raged around the site, the Allied forces pressed forward, moving through the smoke and debris, securing positions as gunfire echoed in the distance.
related_events: Allies advance toward the site after the explosion
Fighting continues in the aftermath of the portal collapse

name: The Blood Ritual in the Sacristy
description: In the dim glow of floodlights, Grigory stands naked in the ancient sacristy, his arms outstretched beside eroded stone saints. Ilsa, a severe and ageless woman, reverently places an embroidered robe over his bony shoulders. He tells her that no matter what happens to him, she must carry on with the work. She refuses to leave, but he insists, commanding her to depart and deny him. In response, he hands her a small leather-bound book filled with hand-drawn notes and illustrations. He pulls her close, their breath visible and mingling in the cold air. Dipping his fingers into a wooden bowl of blood, he wipes her tears with a crimson thumb. In that moment, he grants her everlasting life, youth, and the power to serve him. Von Krup, a German general in dark scarlet glasses and leather gloves, steps into view, checking his pocket watch, its gold lid marked with a swastika. He announces that it is time.
related_events: Grigory instructs Ilsa to continue the work after his fate is sealed
Grigory commands Ilsa to leave and deny him
Grigory hands Ilsa a leather-bound book with hand-drawn notes and illustrations
Grigory embraces Ilsa as their breath mingles in the cold air
Grigory grants Ilsa everlasting life, youth, and power to serve him
Grigory performs a blood ritual by wiping Ilsa's tears with a crimson thumb

name: Von Krup Arrives with the Pocket Watch
description: Von Krup steps into the sacristy, his leather gloves creaking as he pulls a pocket watch from his coat. The gold lid bears a swastika. He flips it open, studies the time, and closes it with a snap. 'It's time,' he says. The air shifts. The ritual halts.
related_events: Von Krup checks his pocket watch with a swastika emblem
Von Krup declares it is time

name: Myers Arrives and Identifies Himself at the Gate
description: A dolled-up MOD-STYLE moped pulls up to a massive gate, carrying a very wet YOUNG MAN named MYERS. Two cheap suitcases are strapped to the luggage rack. Myers reaches out and presses an old-fashioned buzzer mounted beneath a sign that reads 'WASTE MANAGEMENT'. A crackling INTERCOM VOICE responds. 'Yes?' Myers, shivering, says, 'John Myers, F.B.I. Transfer from Quantico.'
related_events: Myers arrives at the gate on a moped with suitcases
Myers activates the buzzer under the 'WASTE MANAGEMENT' sign
Intercom operator responds to Myers' signal
Myers identifies himself as an FBI transfer from Quantico

name: Myers Undergoes Biometric Scan at the Gate
description: After announcing his name and affiliation, Myers waits as a mechanical whirring sound begins. An eyepiece and an LCD screen extend from the gate system. He positions his eye into the device. A brief pause follows, then two violet flashes illuminate the scanner. His identification details, including badge number, appear on the screen. With a sharp clack, the gate unlocks and swings open.
related_events: Security system deploys eyepiece and scanner
Security system verifies Myers' identity with violet flashes
Myers undergoes corneal scan

name: Myers Gains Entry After Biometric Scan
description: Two violet flashes illuminate the screen as Myers' cornea is scanned. His ID and badge numbers appear. A mechanical clack sounds, and the massive gate begins to open, allowing him to pass through the checkpoint.
related_events: Gate unlocks and opens after successful authentication

name: Myers Arrives at B.P.R.D. Lobby for Security Screening
description: Myers approaches a circular desk in the B.P.R.D. lobby where a solitary guard is seated. Before Myers can finish speaking, the guard interrupts, noting he is five minutes late and citing Section 51. He orders Myers to step back. Confused, Myers picks up his suitcases and takes two steps backward, positioning himself at the center of a large B.P.R.D. logo on the floor—a hand holding a sword. The guard instructs him to keep his hands and elbows clear, and immediately the section of floor beneath Myers begins to descend, carrying him downward on a small elevator.
related_events: Myers approaches the circular desk in the lobby
Lobby guard interrupts Myers and enforces protocol

name: Stepping Back onto the Logo
description: Myers picks up his suitcases and takes two steps back as the guard instructed. As he does, he notices he is now standing exactly in the center of a large B.P.R.D. logo on the floor—a hand holding a sword. The moment he settles into position, the floor beneath him begins to move downward, carrying him on a small elevator.
related_events: Myers complies with the guard's instruction to step back
Myers notices he is standing on the center of the B.P.R.D. logo

name: Myers Descends into the Facility
description: After stepping back onto the giant B.P.R.D. logo, Myers stands still as the floor beneath him begins to move. The surface lowers smoothly, revealing that it is a small elevator platform. The descent carries him downward, into a deeper section of the building.
related_events: Floor beneath Myers activates as an elevator

name: Figures Halt at Dead End and Decipher a Carved Symbol
description: The three figures move through a narrow passage until they reach a dead end. Figure 1 stops and notices a symbol carved into the rocky ground. They take out Grigory's leather-bound book and flip through its pages, eventually finding an illustration that matches the symbol. The group remains still, focused on the discovery.
related_events: Three figures reach a dead end in a narrow passage
Figure 1 examines a symbol in the rocky ground
Symbol in the ground matches illustration in Grigory's book

name: Breaking the Ice Barrier
description: The three figures reached a dead end where a symbol was carved into the rocky ground. Figure 1 stopped, consulted a leather-bound book, and compared the symbol to an illustration inside. Satisfied, they took a heavy steel hammer and struck the thick wall of ice ahead. The ice cracked and broke apart, clearing a path forward. The peasant guide stepped back, refusing to go further. Figure 2 pulled out two small gold ingots, handed one to the guide, and kept the other. The guide examined the gold closely, his eyes fixed on the swastika engraved upon it.
related_events: Figure 1 breaks through a thick wall of ice with a steel hammer

name: Figure 2 Pays the Peasant Guide in Gold
description: The Peasant Guide stopped and said he would go no further. Figure 2 took out two small gold ingots, handed one to the guide, and kept the other. The guide looked closely at the ingot, seeing a swastika engraved on its surface, and his expression turned greedy. He made no move to follow them after that.
related_events: Peasant Guide refuses to proceed further
Figure 2 produces two gold ingots
Figure 2 gives one gold ingot to the Peasant Guide
Peasant Guide examines engraved swastika on gold ingot

name: Grigory Initiates the Ritual at the Altar
description: Grigory walks to the top of the altar, cables trailing behind him. He declares that tonight they will open a portal and awaken the OGDRU JAHAD, the seven Gods of chaos. He proclaims that their enemies will be destroyed and all impurity in the world will be razed, giving rise to a new Eden. He looks down at the machine and whispers, 'Ragnarok, Anung Ia Anung.' As he flexes his fingers, the two metal rings around the machine's central axis begin to swing. A sharp TCHINK echoes, followed by a rising WHIRRR. Steam bursts from the ducts and pipes. An invisible force repels the falling rain momentarily from Grigory's body. Ilsa signals to two Nazi scientists at a control panel. 'More Power!! Don't let the level drop!!' One of them inserts a 20-inch solid gold cylinder into the machine. Two openings remain vacant beside it. Suddenly, a blade of light tears open in the air. Burning symbols slash through the darkness, writhing like serpents of fire.
related_events: Grigory announces the opening of a portal to awaken the seven Gods of chaos

name: Grigory Activates the Machine with Incantation and Gesture
description: Grigory stands at the top of the altar, cables trailing behind him. He leans over the machine and whispers, 'Ragnarok, Anung Ia Anung.' As he flexes his fingers, the two metal rings surrounding the machine's central axis begin to swing. A sharp TCHINK! echoes, followed by a rising WHIRRR! Steam bursts from the ducts and pipes. An invisible force radiates outward, pushing the falling rain away from Grigory’s body in all directions.
related_events: Grigory whispers the word Ragnarok to the machine
Grigory activates the machine at the altar
Energy blast deflects falling rain around Grigory

name: Ilsa Orders Power Increase, Scientist Inserts Gold Cylinder
description: Ilsa signals two Nazi scientists at a control panel and shouts for more power, warning them not to let the level drop. One of the scientists responds by inserting a 20-inch solid gold cylinder into the machine. Two openings remain empty beside it.
related_events: Ilsa commands Nazi scientists to increase power to the machine
Nazi scientist inserts solid gold cylinder into the machine

name: Grigory Summons a Blade of Light
description: A blade of light tears open in the air above the machine. Burning symbols spiral through the darkness, writhing like serpents made of fire. They slash across the sky, leaving trails of searing light in their wake.
related_events: Blade of light manifests in the air with burning symbols

name: Ilsa and Kroenen Reveal Themselves After Assassinating the Peasant Guide
description: At the center of the labyrinth, the stone floor bears grooves radiating from a shallow basin. The Peasant Guide uncovers his face and speaks in Romanian, saying they shouldn't be there. Figure 1 and Figure 2 exchange a look. One of the figures throws two solid gold pieces stamped with a swastika at the Sherpa's feet. The Peasant hesitates, then kneels to pick up the coins. Suddenly, a long blade pierces his chest from behind. Figure 2 steps forward, withdrawing the blade, now bloodied. The figures remove their masks, revealing Ilsa, unchanged by time, and Kroenen, still wearing his tight gas mask. Kroenen wipes his blade clean in the snow and retrieves the gold coins. Ilsa watches as the Peasant's blood flows, steaming, tracing a pattern through the grooves and filling the basin. A figure rises from the blood—a naked human form surrounded by fireflies. Ilsa looks at it and says, 'Your eyes. What did they do to your eyes?'
related_events: Peasant Guide reveals his face and speaks in Romanian
Figure 1 and Figure 2 exchange a meaningful look
Figure throws gold pieces with swastika emblem at Sherpa's feet
Peasant Guide kneels to pick up gold after hesitation
Figure 2 stabs Peasant Guide from behind with a long blade
Figure 2 reveals his face and stands over the dying Peasant Guide

name: Ilsa and Kroenen Reveal Themselves After the Assassination
description: After the peasant guide falls, pierced by a blade from behind, the figures remove their hoods. Ilsa stands motionless, her face unchanged by time, watching as the Sherpa's blood flows across the grooved stone, tracing a path toward the basin. Kroenen steps forward from the shadows, wiping his long, bloodied knife in the snow. He bends down, picks up the gold coins marked with swastikas, and pockets them without a word. The blood fills the basin, and a naked figure rises from it, surrounded by a halo of fireflies. Ilsa speaks, her voice low. 'Your eyes. What did they do to your eyes?'
related_events: Ilsa and Kroenen reveal their faces after the assassination
Kroenen cleans his bloody blade in the snow and retrieves the gold pieces

name: The Blood Glyph Awakens a Firefly-Haloed Figure
description: The Sherpa's blood spreads across the stone floor, following the grooves in a steaming trail until it reaches the basin, completing a glowing glyph. From the blood, a naked human figure rises, surrounded by a halo of flickering fireflies. name: Myers and Broom Walk the Artifact Corridor
description: Myers and Broom walk down a corridor lined with glass cases containing occult artifacts. Myers glances at a mummified hand, a clay golem, and a sumptuous pagan altar. Broom points to an ancient, broken lance and explains that Hitler joined the Thule Society, a group of German aristocrats obsessed with the occult. He indicates another case holding an ancient lance and a silver and gold reliquary, stating that Hitler acquired the Spear of Longinus, the weapon said to have pierced the body of Christ, and that whoever holds it becomes invincible. Broom adds that Hitler's power increased tenfold. They pass through a series of pneumatic doors, one section where workmen are replacing two dented metal plates, the damage appearing to come from an oversized fist. Myers stares at the wreckage. Broom says the occult war ended when Adolf Hitler died. Myers corrects him, noting Hitler died in 1945. Broom responds with an enigmatic smile, asking, "Did he, now?" They arrive at a final door made of stainless steel, resembling a bank vault. Agent Clay, a burly man in a suit, waits beside a cart piled high with beef and mashed potatoes. Broom introduces Myers to Clay, hands Myers two Baby Ruth bars, and walks away without entering. Myers asks if Broom is coming. Broom signals no, says he hand-picked Myers from over seventy academy graduates, and tells him to make him proud. The door closes behind Myers. Clay says they aren’t speaking and that Professor Broom had him grounded. Myers asks who is grounded. Clay replies, "Okay. You saw the fish man, right?" Myers nods. Clay says, "Well, come on in and meet the rest of the family," and uses an odd-shaped electronic key to unlock the door. Three solenoid locks disengage, followed by two steel vertical pistons sliding open.

name: The Reading Ritual in the Glass Tank
description: Myers steps into the dimly lit office, surrounded by books and the soft glow of green-shaded lamps. His attention is drawn to a large glass wall enclosing a water tank. A voice crackles from an intercom, instructing him to turn the pages. Startled, Myers moves closer and sees Abe Sapien, a slender, gray-skinned figure with dark markings and bright blue eyes, gliding through the water. Four open books rest on stands facing the glass. Abe reappears, watching him. Myers points at the books in disbelief, asking if Abe is reading them. Abe nods. Professor Broom enters through a side door and introduces himself. He explains that he turns the pages daily while Abe reads all four books at once. Abe presses a webbed hand against the glass, his eyes closing beneath three lids, and speaks through the intercom, reciting details about Myers’ life—his name, his middle initial, his scar. Broom corrects Myers when he refers to Abe as 'it,' stating his name and origin, pointing to a framed inscription on the wall: 'Icthyo Sapiens, April 14, 1865.' Broom reveals a tray of four greenish eggs, which Myers recoils from in disgust. Broom explains they are rotten eggs, a delicacy Abe enjoys. Abe smiles and gracefully retrieves the eggs as they float into the tank. Myers asks how Abe knows so much about him. Broom replies that Abe has a unique frontal lobe. When Myers asks where he is, Broom reminds him of the Latin inscription in the lobby. Myers recalls it: 'In absentia luci, tenebrae vinciunt.' Broom translates: 'In the absence of light, darkness prevails,' and adds, 'For there are things that go bump in the night. We are the ones who bump back.'

description: Clay pushes a supply cart into a windowless concrete bunker, dimly lit and cluttered with samurai armor, weapons, and dozens of cats lounging on furniture. A red tail flicks in and out of a pool of light; one of the cats bats at it playfully. Myers follows, wide-eyed, holding a stack of comic books and Baby Ruth candies. Clay gestures toward a torn comic book cover showing Hellboy in a U.S. uniform battling a monstrous ape. A deep voice speaks from the shadows—'Those comics... They never got the eyes right.' Myers startles as the tail moves again. Across the room, a massive crimson figure lifts a 300-pound stainless steel dumbbell with ease, his biceps straining, an unlit cigar clenched in his teeth. Clay asks where he wants dinner. The figure sets the dumbbell down with a clang, the impact making Myers flinch. 'What's with the hair, Clay? Finally got those implants?' Clay flushes, touching his scalp. 'It'll fill in.' Hellboy steps forward, his red skin textured, golden eyes sunken, horn stumps visible on his forehead. 'Father's back?' he asks. Clay nods. 'Still angry?' 'You broke out,' Clay replies. 'I wanted to see her,' Hellboy grunts. 'It's nobody's business.' Clay turns to Myers. 'Agent Myers is your new liaison.' 'I don't want him,' Hellboy says, dropping the dumbbell. The alarm blares, red lights flashing. 'They're playing our song,' Hellboy says. 'We're on the move. C'mon, Champ! Happy Halloween! You're taking me for a walk!'

A red creature bursts into view, leaping into the air with a screech. Matlin fires, but the creature dodges, springing from arch to arch as bullets strike the stone behind it. Whitman and other soldiers rush in, weapons ready. Matlin calls out that he saw a red ape, but Broom corrects him—it was not an ape, just red. The group listens to labored breathing in the dark. Matlin notes the creature has a large stone in its hand, but Broom observes that the stone is its hand. Hissing, the creature crouches between a gargoyle and a stone saint. Whitman raises his gun, but Broom stops him. From the shadows, golden eyes flecked with burnt sienna watch their movements. Broom pulls a Baby Ruth candy bar from his pocket, peels the wrapper, and takes a loud bite. He offers the candy. After a moment, a small face emerges—resembling the stone demons around it. The creature extends a thick, stone arm etched with tiny runes. Four stone fingers wiggle as they reach for the chocolate. A young soldier exclaims at the sight. Whitman steps closer. On the wall behind him, a shadow shows the creature climbing into Broom’s arms. Broom wraps it in a blanket. The stone fingers snatch the candy. Broom smiles. 'It’s a boy. Just a baby boy.'
